scope: All 357 decision catalogue entries; metadata only, no benchmark imports.
policy: Prefer exact publisher release announcements, dated version histories and explicit per-model release metadata. Named publisher release commits are classified separately; their commit dates do not prove the time a private repository became public. Generic uploads, creation/modified dates, benchmark dates and digits in model names are not accepted. Conflicting exact days may retain their common month; different versions or cross-month conflicts stay unresolved.
